next_step: Run 2-week dedicated capacity POC; capture QPS/concurrency token mix; finalize pricing term sheet
notes:
Account background:
- Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) building in-app assistant + knowledge search and an automated support agent. Product-led growth; tight cost targets but need consistent latency for embedded experience. Trial started on Hosted API (self-serve) Feb 16 - Mar 2.

Hosted trial summary (customer-provided telemetry):
- Duration: 2 weeks, ~12k unique users, ~220k total requests.
- Avg sustained QPS: 8 QPS during weekdays; typical working-hour baseline 12 QPS.
- Peak spikes observed: up to 45 QPS during release mornings (10–11am PST).
- Concurrency observed (mid-trial burst): peak concurrent inflight requests ~30.
- Token mix (derived from logs): ~60% short (<=128 tokens), ~30% medium (129-512), ~10% long (>512). Average tokens per request: ~360 (120 input / 240 output).
- Latency: 95th ~280ms on Hosted with standard model variant; P50 ~85ms. Customer target: P95 <= 250ms (prefer <=200ms) for chat.
- Cost note: Hosted runback estimate ~ $3.8k for trial period (roughly $0.011 / 1k tokens effective due to mixed outputs). Customer is cost sensitive and wants predictable unit economics.

Use-case & requirements (sales/eng notes):
- Primary workloads: in-app assistant (chat + tool calls), document search (reranking + embeddings) for help center, and support automation for Tier 1.
- SLA goals: 99.9% availability, P95 latency <=250ms (target 200ms) for chat flows.
- Throughput ask for Dedicated sizing: sustain 60 QPS with headroom to burst to 150 QPS for release mornings / marketing spikes. Concurrency planning target: 100 concurrent requests.
- Model preference: open weights acceptable (customer wants ability to pin variants), ask for Redwood-recommended quantized model for cost/latency tradeoffs. Needs automatic fallback path to smaller model if capacity constrained.
- Routing/fallback: want policy that favors low-latency region for US users, fallback to lower-cost variant for non-interactive tasks (embeddings / batch rerank).

Security & deployment constraints:
- Will require VPC peering + private network path for Dedicated. Legal requires SOC2 + DPA + audit logs; KMS integration for key management. Data residency conversation ongoing — preference: US-only for now.
- SSO (SAML) integration required for internal admin access.

POC plan discussed (next 2 weeks):
- Redwood to provision a 2-week Dedicated POC environment in customer VPC with 8 GPU tail capacity to validate sustained throughput.
- Metrics to capture: QPS at 50/95/99 percentiles, p95 latency, tokens per minute, GPU utilization, cost per 100k tokens, cold-start effects, cache hit rates for KV/prefix cache.
- Sizing hypothesis: customer expects 8-12 A100-class GPU equivalent will sustain 60 QPS (chat) with 1.5–2x headroom; Redwood SE recommended running loadgen with real token-mix to validate.
- Pricing conversation: mid-market reserved monthly commit vs burst credits. Customer prefers predictable monthly commit if unit economics are close to Hosted trial baseline.

Timeline & recent activities:
- 2026-02-16: Hosted API onboarding, quickstart integration (Dev): auth + request shaping.
- 2026-02-22: Product demo (Maya, Rafael) — focus on streaming + function call examples.
- 2026-02-25: Recorded call (fireflies: ff_20260225_8852) — security Q&A started.
- 2026-03-02: Hosted trial wrap-up meeting (ff_20260302_1190) — shared usage CSV and initial telemetry.
- 2026-03-05: Internal pricing draft sent (drive deck).
- 2026-03-10: Legal kickoff for DPA; network team provided preliminary topology.

Quotes / customer color:
- "We need predictable latency — users notice jitter more than occasional errors." — Head of Product.
- "If we can get predictable monthly costs at the same or lower unit price than Hosted, Dedicated is a go." — CFO (budget owner).

Risks / blockers:
- Network: final VPC peering and NAT routing details outstanding (impacts POC start).
- Legal: DPA review needs redlines; timeline could slip into late April if counters required.
- Budget: Q2 budget approval required for commit above $100k ARR.

Next steps (concrete):

- Customer infra to open network ports + provide VPC peering info by 2026-03-16.
- Schedule kickoff for Dedicated POC week of 2026-03-22 (2-week run).
